spoken_script: Mistral AI secures €3B Series D at €21B valuation. Mistral AI has closed a €3 billion Series D funding round led by Samsung Electronics, pushing the company's valuation past €21 billion. The round includes participation from major global investors including Nvidia, BlackRock, and ASML. Why it matters: This represents the largest private tech equity raise in European history, signaling robust investor appetite for regional AI infrastructure and model development.
